acceptanceCriteria: make no-python-runtime-dependency-test passes on main with the conformance script present.
The carve-out is recorded in GOC-V0-008 and has a self-test proving a genuine python3 invocation elsewhere still fails.
Nightly release-gates no longer fails on this step.
body: Scheduled release-gates on 714393264 (run 39258757168) fails no-python-runtime-dependency-test on macos-15 and ubuntu-24.04: script/spec-toolchain-conformance.sh (V1-1697, STA-V0 conformance job) names python3/pip to install third-party Spec Kit. GOC-V0-008 scans script/*.sh. Conflict between GOC-V0-008 and STA-V0: the external tool's interpreter is that tool's runtime, not Corvint's. Resolve with an explicit, spec-recorded carve-out (e.g. an opt-in like CORVINT_TEST_EXTERNAL_PYTEST, or a named external-conformance exemption with a falsifying self-test) or by moving the install out of the scanned path under an amended GOC-V0-008. Tracked by GH #1116.
title: Nightly full-gate red: GOC-V0-008 no-python check flags script/spec-toolchain-conformance.sh (STA-V0 Spec Kit install via python3/pip)
